recipe.visualDefinition: A four-panel grid featuring stylized, low-resolution pixel art avatars of four distinct characters, set against vibrant, high-saturation background squares and framed by a solid black border with futuristic typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between neon backgrounds and black framing
Consistent pixel-scale across all four character avatars
Typographic alignment centered above and below the central graphic
coreInvariants: Square aspect ratio for the central grid
Drop shadows on pixel characters to create depth
Uniform pixel size for all character features

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four centered avatars occupying equal quadrants within a central square frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intersection point of the four colored quadrants.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern starting from top-left quadrant to top-right, then bottom-left to bottom-right, framed by top and bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black margins surrounding the central grid provide breathing room for the display type.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: High-saturation neon primaries (Orange, Lime Green, Magenta, Cyan) as quadrant backgrounds.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the outer frame and character outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light grey/silver for the futuristic typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Maximum saturation in the center grid contrasted against zero-value black surroundings.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended geometric sans-serif with futuristic, tech-inspired modifications.
letterConstructionRules: Horizontal bars extending from the tops or bottoms of letters to create continuous lines
Open counters and simplified geometric shapes
Rounded external corners with sharp internal angles
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'E' lacks a middle bar or uses a stylized horizontal extension
The letter 'A' is rendered as a simple triangle or trapezoid
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for both top and bottom text to maintain brand consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base geometric width and futuristic feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 2x2 grid of four solid neon squares (Orange, Green, Pink, Blue). In each square, place a centered 8-bit pixel art character bust with a slight drop shadow. Frame the entire grid with a thick black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom vector lettering in a futuristic, wide geometric style at the top and bottom of the black frame. Use a light grey color and ensure horizontal bars connect or underline the text segments.

verificationChecks: Are the characters rendered in a consistent 8-bit pixel style?
Does the typography feature horizontal bar extensions?
Is the color palette limited to high-saturation neons and black?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the outer black frame
mustRedesign: Original band and album name text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is garbled or nonsensical.
Check that pixel characters are centered in their respective squares.
Verify the black border is uniform on all sides.
Confirm the typography maintains a futuristic, wide-set appearance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 2x2 neon pixel-art grid with wide, futuristic display type in a black frame for a retro-digital aesthetic.
